sponsor_or_proposer: Shell Egypt, EGAS, Petronas (FEED to Bechtel-led coalition with Enppi and Petrojet)
current_state: FEED awarded Sept 2022 for a 'One Power Hub' concept integrating the electrical power systems of the West Delta Deep Marine (WDDM) gas plant and the Egyptian LNG (ELNG/Idku) terminal to cut energy use and emissions. Not an LNG liquefaction/regasification capacity expansion.
missing_threshold_elements: Does NOT meet the LNG add-bar: it is a power-systems integration/emissions-optimization study at the EXISTING Idku terminal, not a new LNG terminal or a new train/unit. No new LNG capacity, no new FID for liquefaction. Already covered by the existing Egyptian LNG Terminal record (T100000130250).
watch_for: Any pivot from power integration to actual LNG liquefaction debottlenecking/expansion or a new train at Idku that would add nameplate capacity, or an FID on new LNG output.
notes: Logged for completeness so a future batch doesn't mistake the 'Idku Energy Hub' headline for a new LNG terminal. No new_terminal/new_unit record warranted.
